tagline: Audits a fleet of bots for the habits that quietly burn tokens

source.excerpt: Shared as a cost audit for anyone running enough bots to have stopped counting.

body:
## What it does

Reads back through what your bots have been saying and where their recurring jobs overlap, then names the waste: a conversation circling the same ground, two timers firing for one task, an expensive model doing something trivial. Each finding arrives with the change that would stop it.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @from_glasses shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
